name: Ailuro Hero (3pp)
source: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition
book: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition

facets.bk: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition

body:
Ailuropoda is equal parts peaceful and savage. After growing to a point where it loses its ability to stand upright, ailuro help this monster to don its harness so that it can be ridden into battle. Curiously, some ailuropoda have learned to use the end of their harness as a slingshot for a variety of projectiles.

Monster Trainer Spells
Monstorin Stats

AILUROPODA
CR 12

XP 19,200
N Large magical beast
Init +5; Senses darkvision 60 ft., see in darkness; Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 10, flat-footed 18 (+1 Dex, +9 natural, –1 size)
hp 138 (12d10+72)
Fort +14, Ref +9, Will +5
DR 10/evil or silver; Resist cold 15, fire 15; SR 23

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., climb 30 ft. Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft. (bite, 5 ft.)
Melee 2 claws +10 (1d6+8, plus rend), bite +10 (1d8+8)
Special Attacks rend (2 claws, 1d6+12)

STATISTICS

Str 27, Dex 13, Con 23, Int 6, Wis 12, Cha 10
Base Atk +12; CMB +21 (+23 bull rush); CMD 32 (34 vs. bull rush)
Feats Improved Initiative, Power Attack, Weapon Finesse, Improved Natural Attack (bite), Improved Critical (bite), Improved Bull Rush
Skills Climb +18 (+22 in forests), Perception +12, Stealth +11 (+15 in forests)
Languages understands Common and Elven
SQ tree shape (3/day, as ailuro)

Note: Ailuropoda can be used as an exotic mount. Its bamboo harness can seat a Medium or Small-sized creature.
